title: External-agents team config
description: Schema for a repository's <home>/external-agents.yaml (<home> defaults to docs/conventions): the team layer of the external-agents plugin. A personal <home>/external-agents.local.yaml overrides it per key. Layers: docs/contracts/config-cascade/README.md. Each product is one top-level key holding its per-product keys; an unset model, effort or profile leaves the CLI's own configuration in charge.

schema.description: The layer format version. The resolver skips a layer that declares any other value.

codex.description: Settings for the OpenAI Codex CLI.

model.description: Model passed to the CLI. Unset: the CLI's configured or recommended default.

effort.description: Reasoning effort passed to the CLI. Unset: the CLI's own setting.

profile.description: CLI configuration profile to run under. Unset: none.

binary_path.description: Absolute path to the CLI binary, tried before every other location. Read from the personal layer only: a value in the committed team file is ignored, since it picks the executable that runs.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before a run is stopped and recorded timed-out.

update_hint.description: Text shown beside the daily check's line when the CLI is behind its latest release, such as how your machines update it.

mode.description: Default and ceiling for task runs.
Default and ceiling for investigate runs.

enabled.description: Whether review:council may run this CLI as a member.

antigravity.description: Settings for the Google Antigravity CLI (agy).

model.description: Model slug passed to the CLI, from `agy models`. Unset: no `--model` is passed and agy uses its own default.

effort.description: Reasoning effort passed to the CLI. Unset: the CLI's own setting.

binary_path.description: Absolute path to the CLI binary, tried before every other location. Read from the personal layer only: a value in the committed team file is ignored, since it picks the executable that runs.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before a run is stopped and recorded timed-out.

update_hint.description: Text shown beside the daily check's line when the CLI is behind its latest release, such as how your machines update it.

mode.description: Default and ceiling for task runs. Write is opt-in: agy's write mode has no network isolation (ADR 0119).
Default and ceiling for investigate runs.

enabled.description: Whether review:council may run this CLI as a member.

cooldown_hours.description: Hours a CLI stays refused after an unavailable-class failure, unless the CLI names its own reset time.

keep.description: Newest job files kept per repository.
